name: CustomXMLSchema
description: Represents a schema in a CustomXMLSchemaCollection collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CustomXMLSchema object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLSchema object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CustomXMLSchema object. Read-only.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Gets a String that represents the location of a schema on a computer. Read-only.

properties.name: NamespaceURI
properties.description: Gets the unique address identifier for the namespace of the CustomXMLSchema object. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified schema from the CustomXMLSchema collection.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads a schema from a file.
